metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds one word on the tables, fourteen lines asked, and Mistress Vernon as talk.

yesterday: The word is on the leaf.
My lord is at Holborn for two nights. He asked for fourteen lines.
The groom's talk is Mistress Vernon, and the court says so.
You played Egeon. The Rose had the second Hercules.
Tomorrow is the other king at two.
